## History

Robert Bell previously owned a farm that adjoined the [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) property to the west. In early April, before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returned home from Queen's, he sold his farm and relocated to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)_
